headline: Nvidia is reported to be discussing an investment in the AI search company Perplexity that would value it at more than $30 billion.
score_reason: Large reported valuation jump, but only talks, relayed by a second outlet, with an unconfirmed revenue figure.
importance_line: If the talks lead to a deal, the leading AI chip maker would add another stake in an AI company at a very high price for its sales, which matters to investors and to people who use AI search; the talks and the revenue figure are unconfirmed, and critics call such investments circular financing, which Nvidia denies.
summary: The Information reports, as relayed by Startup Fortune, that Nvidia is in talks to invest in Perplexity, an AI-powered search company, at a valuation above $30 billion, up from about $23 billion in a funding round that closed in January 2026. No deal is final and neither company has commented; Startup Fortune adds that the price would be about 40 times Perplexity's reported annual revenue run rate of $750 million, a figure it says no one has confirmed.
notes: Original The Information report not opened; text read on Startup Fortune.
